chunks: Thuwair ibn Abī Fākhitah narrated from his father, from ʿAlī عليه السلام, who said:

Kisrā sent a gift to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله, and he accepted it. Qayṣar sent a gift to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله, and he accepted it. And the kings sent gifts to him, and he accepted them.

key_terms.أَهْدَى: sent as a gift or presented a gift
key_terms.قَيْصَرُ: Qayṣar, the Caesar or Byzantine ruler
key_terms.لِلنَّبِيِّ: to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله accept gifts from non-Muslim rulers and kings?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله accepted gifts sent by major rulers such as Kisrā and Qayṣar, as well as other kings. It reflects the Prophetic sunnah regarding receiving gifts and indicates a pattern of diplomatic and social exchange.
